public_rationale: The claim is read as saying the OpenAI expansion at Abilene was never a committed plan. He calls it 'supposedly-planned.' On September 23, 2025, OpenAI described it only as an 'additional potential expansion of 600 megawatts' near the Abilene site (e1). A Tom's Hardware report published March 10, 2026 says Oracle and OpenAI dropped plans that month to expand beyond the committed 1.2-gigawatt build after financing negotiations failed (e3). The same report calls the expansion lease 'never-finalized.' It quotes OpenAI executive Sachin Katti as saying the company 'considered expanding it further' and chose to direct that capacity to other locations (e2). The cited reports do not show a signed lease or committed financing for the expansion. Financing negotiations did take place (e3), so 'never existed' holds only in the sense of 'never committed.' 'Was never going to happen' is about intent and is not scored.
limitations: The result depends on reading 'never existed' as 'never committed.' Read literally, the claim is too strong, because an expansion was announced and negotiated.
'Was never going to happen' is about intent and is not scored.
The account of the dropped expansion comes from a secondary report summarizing Bloomberg and The Information. The original reports were not read.
The record does not show whether any non-binding term sheet or letter of intent was signed for the OpenAI expansion.
The same report says Oracle called early coverage 'false and incorrect.' The record does not set out exactly what Oracle disputed.

On March 27, 2026, Crusoe announced a 900 MW campus next to the existing Abilene site to support Microsoft (e4). The record does not show how, if at all, that campus relates to the capacity once considered for OpenAI.

from_speaker: OpenAI not taking the supposedly-planned extensions to Abilene
our_interpretation: 'Supposedly-planned' concedes that an expansion was announced or reported. The testable claim is that the OpenAI expansion at Abilene was never a real, committed plan: no signed lease, financing or construction for OpenAI.
'Was never going to happen' is a counterfactual about intent and is not scored on its own. It is treated as consistent with the claim if the expansion was never committed and was dropped.
An expansion later built on adjacent land for a different tenant (Microsoft) does not bear on whether an OpenAI expansion ever existed.
The target period runs from the September 2025 announcement of a 'potential' expansion to the post date.
criteria.support_condition: Records show the OpenAI Abilene expansion was only ever described as potential or tentative, never reached a signed lease or committed financing, and was dropped.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records show a signed lease, committed financing, or construction under way specifically for an OpenAI expansion at Abilene before it was dropped.
